question: For each bond type (single, double, triple), identify the top 3 most common elements that participate in those bonds within carcinogenic molecules. Then, count how many distinct non-carcinogenic molecules contain at least one of these top elements in any bond type. Finally, calculate the percentage of these non-carcinogenic molecules relative to all non-carcinogenic molecules in the database.

prediction.sql:
WITH TopElements AS (
    SELECT 
        b.XCL_006 AS bond_type,
        a.XCL_003 AS element,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.XCL_006 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM atom a
    INNER JOIN molecule m ON a.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010
    INNER JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
    WHERE m.XCL_011 = '+'
    GROUP BY b.XCL_006, a.XCL_003
),
Top3Elements AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT element
    FROM TopElements
    WHERE rn <= 3
),
NonCarcMolsWithTopElements AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010
    FROM molecule m
    INNER JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
    INNER JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
    WHERE m.XCL_011 = '-'
    AND a.XCL_003 IN (SELECT element FROM Top3Elements)
),
AllNonCarcMols AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT XCL_010
    FROM molecule
    WHERE XCL_011 = '-'
)
SELECT 
    t.bond_type,
    t.element,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NonCarcMolsWithTopElements) AS matching_non_carc_molecules,
    CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NonCarcMolsWithTopElements) AS REAL) * 100 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM AllNonCarcMols) AS percentage
FROM TopElements t
WHERE t.rn <= 3
ORDER BY t.bond_type, t.rn

WITH carcinogenic_molecules AS (

    FROM molecule m
    WHERE m.XCL_011 = 'carcinogenic'

bond_elements AS (
    SELECT 
        b.XCL_004 AS bond_id,
        b.XCL_005 AS molecule_id,
        c.XCL_009 AS bond_type,
        a1.XCL_003 AS element1,
        a2.XCL_003 AS element2
    FROM bond b
    JOIN connected c ON b.XCL_004 = c.XCL_009
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.XCL_007 = a1.XCL_001
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.XCL_008 = a2.XCL_001
),
element_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        bond_type,
        element,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM (
        SELECT bond_type, element1 AS element FROM bond_elements WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM carcinogenic_molecules)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT bond_type, element2 AS element FROM bond_elements WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM carcinogenic_molecules)
    )
    GROUP BY bond_type, element
),
ranked_elements AS (
    SELECT 
        bond_type,
        element,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bond_type ORDER BY cnt DESC) AS rn
    FROM element_counts
),
top_elements AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT element
    FROM ranked_elements
    WHERE rn <= 3
),
non_carcinogenic_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010 AS molecule_id
    FROM molecule m
    WHERE m.XCL_011 != 'carcinogenic'
),
molecules_with_top_elements AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT be.molecule_id
    FROM bond_elements be
    JOIN top_elements te ON be.element1 = te.element OR be.element2 = te.element
    WHERE be.molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM non_carcinogenic_molecules)
),
counts AS (
    SELECT 
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecules_with_top_elements) AS with_top_count,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM non_carcinogenic_molecules) AS total_non_carc_count
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(100.0 * with_top_count / total_non_carc_count, 2) AS percentage
FROM counts
